user.title: Weather Summary
user.description: Choose where the forecast comes from and which free LLM writes the short sentence. Open-Meteo needs no key; OpenWeatherMap, WeatherAPI.com and Windy use their (free) keys — note Windy's free tier returns shuffled test data with 3-hourly rain. For the LLM, 'Gemini' takes a key from aistudio.google.com/apikey, 'OpenAI-compatible' covers Ollama (e.g. 192.168.1.50:11434/v1), 'Home Assistant' uses the LLM already configured in HA, 'None' uses a built-in template.
